answer: The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, revoked by a single upheld challenge, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The wander is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the horizon. Reaching the timber of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
